}}'''Rhea''' was a [[Da'shain Aiel]] and the daughter of [[Adan]] and [[Siedre]].

== History ==
She was the last of her siblings to survive, the others being [[Sorelle]], [[Marind]], [[Elwin]] and [[Jaren]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Rhea|comp}}

She was kidnapped along with several other women during the [[Breaking of the World]]. Her fate is unknown.{{ref/book|4|26}}

==Errata==
She is listed as [[Jenn Aiel]] in [[The Wheel of Time Companion]], but the term Jenn did not exist until long after her kidnapping. She should be Da'shain Aiel.{{ref||comp}}
